verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's own docs describe granular branch-level permissions and organization-wide 'standardized, customizable merge checks' that enforce code quality and CI/CD policies, which covers the core of gating merges on protected branches. The tag mention in the evidence refers to package and container image tags, not git tag protection, and all of this rests on marketing-level product-page copy. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of required-approval counts and required passing builds as merge checks, git tag protection rules, in-depth docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
